experiment.availability_assumption: At each simulated origin, all validated observations through the preceding quarter are assumed available. Actual publication delays and historical revisions are unknown.
experiment.selection_rule: Fixed ridge candidate must lower MAE versus seasonal naive in both 2021–2023 and 2024–2025; otherwise retain seasonal naive. Release selection is exploratory, not independent prospective validation.

forecast.label: Retrospective estimate from the latest historical cutoff; not a current-quarter forecast.
